# 🌍 Inbound Authentication Origins

Maps the external source IP (`RemoteIP`) of remote logons from `DeviceLogonEvents`. Bubble size = attempts, color (red→green) = successful logons. The bubble to fear is a `LogonSuccess` from a country you don't operate in.

> Enriched with the native `geo_info_from_ip_address()` function. Geo data (MaxMind GeoLite2) is approximate — read as regions, not pinpoints.

## 1️⃣ Inbound Authentication Origins — `DeviceLogonEvents`

Maps the external source IP (`RemoteIP`) of remote logons. Bubble **size** = number of attempts; color (red→green) = successful logons. **The bubble to fear is a `LogonSuccess` from a country you don't operate in.**

content.title: Inbound auth origins — bubble size = total attempts

content.query:
// Companion grid: same data, ranked, with the accounts touched per source.
DeviceLogonEvents
| where Timestamp {TimeRange}
| where RemoteIPType == "Public" and isnotempty(RemoteIP)
| where LogonType in ("Network", "RemoteInteractive")
| extend geo = geo_info_from_ip_address(RemoteIP)
| summarize Attempts  = count(),
            Successes = countif(ActionType == "LogonSuccess"),
            Failures  = countif(ActionType == "LogonFailed"),
            Devices   = dcount(DeviceName),
            Accounts  = make_set(AccountName, 25)
         by RemoteIP,
            Country = tostring(geo.country),
            City    = tostring(geo.city)
| order by Successes desc, Attempts desc
content.title: Source IP breakdown (success vs. fail)
